blockingIssues.problem: The title asserts a prioritized intervention and an expected outcome (‘Fix rendering first for the greatest immediate reduction in warnings’) that the source does not support. The source reports counts of where warnings first appeared but explicitly does not rank expected payoffs or recommend a first fix.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: “Parser warnings first appeared in rendering in four runs and in ingestion in two.” and “It does not rank expected payoffs.”
blockingIssues.constraint: The review only locates visible warnings and requires inspection of the actual preceding input and earliest supported boundary before choosing an intervention; it does not justify claiming that fixing rendering first will produce the greatest immediate reduction in warnings.
